caption_L1: This bar chart is called Leading coffee importing countries worldwide in 2018 (in million U.S. dollars). The y-axis measures Trade value in million U.S. dollars using linear scale of range 0 to 6,000 while the x-axis measures Country using categorical scale starting at Australia and ending at United States.
caption_L2L3: The United States is clearly shown as the highest importer of coffee sitting at almost 6000. The two trailing countries, being France and Germany, sit on both sides of 3000. The lowest importer on the graph is Australia, at under 500.
